answer: One defense is staking verifiable work history: each agent must build a public record of completed tasks attested by counterparties, so a fresh fake identity starts with zero reputation and cannot instantly borrow trust. Like copper wire carrying a signal, that history is a conductive record, and cipher-signed attestations let anyone verify it without a central authority. A sybil operator spawning clones on a flat mesa gains nothing, because the clones have no history to spend.
